answer: The gale vault test admits a newcomer only through a sealed vault at the inlet. A newcomer posts a $6 bond and seals one vault at the inlet before the gale arrives; when the gale passes, two inlet keepers check the seal within the hour, and a broken seal, a copied seal, or a vault never sealed burns the bond. One honest newcomer risks $6 and one sealed vault; faking a hundred needs a hundred vaults and $600 locked.
